cues.en: Instructor: I really enjoy coming up with these unsupervised learning challenges.
cues.zh: 講師：我真的很喜歡設計這些「非監督式學習」挑戰。

cues.en: I hope you enjoy working through them and, well, of course I hope you enjoy the entire course, but, in particular, these learning challenges.
cues.zh: 希望你也喜歡完成它們，當然也希望你喜歡整門課，但尤其是這些學習挑戰。

cues.en: Okay, so what you want to do here is explore the relationship between probability and odds.
cues.zh: 這次要探索機率和勝算之間的關係。

cues.en: So you'll remember in the previous video, I gave you a formula for computing the probability based on what I called N and M,
cues.zh: 還記得前一部影片，我給了一個根據 N 和 M 計算機率的公式，

cues.en: but these are basically the two numbers that you use to compute an odds ratio.
cues.zh: 這兩個基本上就是計算勝算比所使用的數字。

cues.en: So if you say six to one against, if the odds are six to one against, then N is six and M is one.
cues.zh: 例如，不發生對發生的比是六比一，那 N 就是 6，M 就是 1。

cues.en: So what you do here is create a big matrix of probability values.
cues.zh: 這裡要建立一個很大的機率值矩陣。

cues.en: So these are probability values in the color axis, and the X axis has M and the Y axis has N.
cues.zh: 顏色軸表示機率值，X 軸是 M，Y 軸是 N。

cues.en: So what you need to do is basically translate the formula to compute probability from N and M, and it was presented in the previous video,
cues.zh: 基本上，把前一部影片中，根據 N、M 計算機率的公式轉換過來，

cues.en: and then you want to implement that formula for a range of Ns and a range of Ms.
cues.zh: 再針對一系列 N 值和 M 值實作這個公式。

cues.en: Now, I have chosen to set M to go from 1 to 11 and N to go from 1 to 10.
cues.zh: 我選擇讓 M 從 1 到 11，N 從 1 到 10。

cues.en: Of course, you're welcome to use different ranges if you want, but then it's pretty interesting to meditate on this matrix for a while.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以使用其他範圍，但花點時間仔細觀察這個矩陣會很有趣。

cues.en: In particular, notice how the colors change.
cues.zh: 特別注意顏色如何改變。

cues.en: So when is the probability close to zero?
cues.zh: 什麼情況下，機率接近 0？

cues.en: When is the probability close to one?
cues.zh: 什麼情況下，機率接近 1？

cues.en: And where in this matrix is the probability close to 0.5?
cues.zh: 矩陣中的哪裡，機率接近 0.5？

cues.en: These are the, you know, interesting ranges of probabilities to pay attention to.
cues.zh: 這些就是值得注意的有趣機率範圍。

cues.en: So close to zero, close to one, and exactly 0.5, or you know, very close to 0.5, and how that relates to different values of M and N,
cues.zh: 也就是接近 0、接近 1，以及恰好 0.5，或非常接近 0.5；想想它們和不同 M、N 值的關係，

cues.en: and how that relates back to the way you would describe odds as being two to seven against, or, you know, 11 to 3 against.
cues.zh: 以及如何對應回不發生對發生的比為二比七，或十一比三這樣的描述方式。

cues.en: So good luck; I hope you find it enjoyable, and if you make some really amazing discoveries about the relationship between probability and odds,
cues.zh: 祝你好運，希望你喜歡。如果對機率和勝算的關係有什麼很棒的發現，

cues.en: feel free to post your discoveries to the Q&A for this lecture.
cues.zh: 歡迎把發現貼到這堂課的問答區。

cues.en: I will enjoy reading them and I think other students would benefit from them as well.
cues.zh: 我會很開心閱讀，也相信其他同學能從中受益。
